title: Thai Breakfast Omelette
description: A delicious and filling breakfast dish inspired by Thai cuisine, featuring a unique and umami-packed omelette filled with fresh fish and spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Add the fish sauce and stir to combine.
Add the flaked fish and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour the egg mixture over the fish mixture and cook until the eggs are almost set.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve hot.
